Discrepancies found:
1. bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 instead of expected 10 per spec.
2. parse_coupon is case-sensitive and rejects valid lowercase codes; should ignore case.
3. Cart.items() returns {'apple': 3} but spec expects value tuple (unit_price, quantity).
4. Cart.remove_item leaves quantity as int rather than unit_price tuple.
5. Cart.total does not apply coupon correctly; calculation yields 915 instead of expected 909 for 10% discount.
